Compiled builds of four MIT-licensed packages from
[liguobao/ds-harness-remote](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote)
at commit ea1c0925f8be825a5f5afac32ad2d0b2c699f7f7 (`packages/protocol`, `crypto`, `webrtc`,
`client-core`), used by the app to reach DSH Remote Hosts. Not edited here;
to update, rebuild them in that repository (`tsc -p tsconfig.json` in each
package) and copy each `dist/`. See `LICENSE`.
